The calculations behind the case study of the article Addressing Uncertainty in Socio-Ecological Transformation of the Chemical Industry with Reliability Life Cycle Optimization (Environmental Science & Technology): a reliability (chance-constrained) life cycle optimization of European ammonia production on ecoinvent 3.10 cut-off with the IPCC 2013 GWP100 and its uncertainty, solved with PULPO 2.0.0.
